producer_report.summary:
I couldn't reproduce either failure on the current tree, because both were already fixed there. The xtask cause (ETXTBSY) is inferred from the old CI log and a stress count, not reproduced. The only code change is that the xtask failure now says why it failed.

- **xtask repin test:**
  - **Cause:** `exec` of a script that some process still held open for writing fails with ETXTBSY. The CI log showed a 69-test binary with the panic at `main.rs:850`, which is an older tree than this one (83 tests before my change). That tree wrote the stand-in in-process and had no retry.
  - **Already fixed at base:** `write_executable` (writes through an `sh` child and renames) and `retry_busy`. They landed after that CI run.
  - **Measured:** `cargo test -p athena-testkit --test stand_in_stress` gave 22 busy files in 800 cycles for the in-process writer and 0 for the helper. The repin test never failed in 200 runs, even with the stand-in written in-process, at 64 threads and 32 loader threads.
  - **Change:** `found` hid the real error behind "`claude --version` failed". A new `run_first_line` returns the io error with its os error number, or the exit status plus stderr. `found` now calls it and keeps its old result, and `repin_at` appends the reason. A new test, `a_failed_version_run_names_the_io_error_or_the_exit_status`, covers it.
- **Drain pid-file test:**
  - **Cause:** the stand-in drain exited at the stop file, about 50 ms after the first stop call. Under load it could be gone before the waiting call looked, so that call read `NotRunning(Dead)` instead of `Exited`.
  - **Already fixed at base:** a release file that the waiting call's first lookup creates.
  - **Measured:** with the old script shape restored (since put back), the test failed 2 of 200 runs at 64 threads and 32 loader threads. The current code failed 0 of 200, both with default threads and under that load.

`drain.rs` is unchanged. The entry I added to `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed names both causes and gives the 200-run commands, thread counts, load and before/after counts, measured on this machine.

The loop was a throwaway Rust program, since deleted.

`cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask` (84 passed), `cargo test -p athena-cli --lib` (140 passed), `cargo test -p xtask --test policy`, fmt and clippy all pass. I did not run the full `cargo test`; I left it to Athena's checks.

I left `crates/athena-testkit/src/lib.rs` and `crates/athena-agent/src/procs.rs` unchanged, because the causes were already fixed there.

checks_run.command: 200-run loops of each test binary (throwaway Rust loop, deleted)
checks_run.note: after: 0/200 in 5 runs; before drain (old stand-in script): 2/200 at 64 threads + 32 loaders

Each cause is specific (the syscall, race or timing assumption), not 'flaky'. Check with Grep for both test names in CHANGELOG.md.
criteria_check.evidence: New first entry under Fixed names both tests: ETXTBSY on exec of an in-process-written stand-in (inferred from the old tree in the CI log plus the stand_in_stress count), and the stand-in drain exiting at the stop file before the waiting call looked.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md states how the 200-run check was measured: the exact command, the test-thread count, any added load, and the before and after failure counts. Check by reading the entry; a number without a command fails this criterion.
criteria_check.evidence: The entry gives build commands, a direct 200-run loop reading 'test <name> ... ok', default and --test-threads 64/256, loaders 16/32/128, before 2/200 drain, after 0/200, and the stress command with 22/800 vs 0/800. It says the repin flake was not reproduced locally.

criteria_check.criterion: No coverage is removed: `git diff` shows no deleted #[test] function, and Grep still finds repin_sets_only_the_version_and_is_idempotent in xtask/src/main.rs and status_and_stop_find_the_drain_by_pid_file_when_command_lines_contain_drain in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, with every assertion of the latter still present (the decoy untouched, the pid in status, Exited after the wait, the Dead state).
criteria_check.evidence: drain.rs is unchanged (git status shows only CHANGELOG.md and xtask/src/main.rs); the xtask diff only adds a function and a test; both tests ran ok.

criteria_check.criterion: The xtask failure is no longer opaque: the diff makes repin_at or found report the underlying io error or exit status rather than only 'claude --version failed', or removes the source of the failure, and a test or the test body covers it. Check by reading the diff in xtask/src/main.rs.
criteria_check.evidence: run_first_line returns the io error with the os error number or the exit status plus stderr; repin_at appends it; the new test a_failed_version_run_names_the_io_error_or_the_exit_status covers a missing program, a failing one and repin_at and passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --lib` as separate commands; both pass, including each named test, which runs in the parallel binary with default threads.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran both: 84 passed and 140 passed; the named tests are ok in each.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` as separate commands; all pass, or a passing Athena-recorded check on the same final tree is cited (D115).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full cargo test. I ran cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -D warnings, both clean, and the per-crate tests above.

criteria_check.criterion: No unrelated behavior changes: `git diff --stat` lists only the deliverables; production code of drain.rs and xtask (outside test modules and any minimal error-reporting change in found/repin_at) is unchanged; athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows and records/ are untouched.
criteria_check.evidence: git status shows only CHANGELOG.md and xtask/src/main.rs modified. The production change is limited to found, which delegates to the new run_first_line, and repin_at's error text. found no longer sets stderr null, so it captures stderr instead of discarding it; the behavior is the same.

open_issues: The repin test's CI failure was not reproduced locally, so its ETXTBSY cause is inferred from the older tree in the CI log and from stand_in_stress. If it recurs on the current tree, the new message will show the real error.
The full `cargo test` was not run by me; it is left to Athena's checks.
mistakes: I deleted my throwaway loop program before running the new error-path test in the loop. Final-code runs of the repin test were made before that test was added, but the added test does not touch the repin path.
learnings: Both flakes were already mitigated at base: write_executable plus retry_busy for xtask, and the release file for the drain test. The CI log in the verifier brief of 20261106-022423-vdtn shows a 69-test xtask binary with the panic at line 850, which is an older tree than base (83 tests).
Old drain test shape (stand-in exits at the stop file) fails 2/200 at 64 threads with 32 forking loader threads.
The repin test itself does not reproduce ETXTBSY locally even with an in-process writer, so only the stand_in_stress count (22/800) shows the race.
desires: Permission to run a shell loop or script, so a 200-run measurement does not need a throwaway Rust program.
The CI log of the failing runs, which would show the actual io error.
